name: Plaid
one_liner: Financial data API for connecting end-user bank accounts to apps via Plaid Link, with webhooks, OpenAPI spec and SDKs.
auth_notes: Server calls use client_id plus secret from the Dashboard. End users link banks through Plaid Link producing a public token exchanged for an access token. OAuth client_credentials tokens exist for the Dashboard MCP server.
access_notes: Sandbox keys come from a free Dashboard signup. Production requires applying for Production access; pricing is shown only on application. Free Trial (10 production Items) only for new US/Canada teams; EU/UK customers only get Custom plans.

buildability.rationale: Sandbox is self-serve and the API is documented, but Production needs an approved application, some products are Custom-plan only, and the Dashboard MCP covers diagnostics only, not bank data.

disputes.why: Pricing page says apply for Production access; trial limited to US/Canada; EU/UK Custom only.
Production access requires an application and approval.
Many products listed (Auth, Identity, Balance, Transactions, Investments, Liabilities, Income, Transfer, etc.).
Plaid-hosted Dashboard MCP; production-only diagnostics scope.
client_id and secret are static API credentials; public-token exchange is the other mechanism.

auth.quote: You'll need API keys, which you can receive by signing up in the Dashboard.
create an OAuth token with the mcp:dashboard scope and the client_credentials grant type

access.quote: To view pricing, apply for Production access.
